ModMetaData.name: AKMS by Wololooo
ModMetaData.author: wololooo
ModMetaData.description: The AKM with a folding stock — built for paratroopers who needed to fit through a hatch. The last weapon in the Krasnaya Zvezda's Soviet archive. The lineage that began with Fyodorov ends here, in airborne doctrine and folding steel.
